items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, his name was Buster Brown, and he had a dance hall up there.

ctx.x: Yeah, his name was Buster Brown, and he had a dance hall up there. He had a dance hall at Washington and Central, and I started to playing in there one night, after they found out I could play a cornet, you know. Didn't call it trumpet at that time. It was the cornet. If we called a cornet a trumpet, somebody called you down. So I was playing -- I went up there to play one night and played a pretty good job. I thought I was doing fine, you know. But a fellow walked in there by the name of Ernest Coycal -- Dink --…
